comparison.objective: Invert and reinsert an AC disconnect pull-out, close its cover, and padlock it; candidate transfers an uncaged guide block to a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests cover holding, retained block extraction/reorientation/reinsertion, and shackle latching. Candidate tests flush rail–jig mating and straight supported transfer without exposing free balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires OFF orientation, closed cover, locked shackle, release, and a 20 N verification while leaving the other disconnect untouched. Candidate requires complete block transfer, continuous support, all balls retained, and no contamination or damage.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate a removable block, the record tests reorientation and safety lockout, not seam-crossing support continuity for free internal elements.
